Name: NewID
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: NewID, command: one)
SELECT gen_random_uuid() AS id;

Name: LockAccount
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: LockAccount, command: exec)
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock($1::bigint);

Name: TryLock
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: TryLock, command: one)
SELECT pg_try_advisory_lock($1::bigint) AS locked;

Name: Notify
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Notify, command: exec)
SELECT pg_notify('events', $1);

Name: Setting
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:current_setting('search_path')⟩ AS path, ⟨c1 aliased:current_setting('app.tenant', true)⟩ AS tenant,\n       ⟨c2 aliased:pg_size_pretty(1024::bigint)⟩ AS size;

Name: Statistics
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Statistics, command: one)
SELECT corr(ratio, amount) AS correlation, regr_slope(ratio, amount) AS slope, regr_count(ratio, amount) AS pairs,
       any_value(body) AS sample, string_agg(raw, '\x00'::bytea) AS joined
FROM events;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:corr(ratio, amount)⟩ AS correlation, ⟨c1 aliased:regr_slope(ratio, amount)⟩ AS slope, ⟨c2 aliased:regr_count(ratio, amount)⟩ AS pairs,\n       ⟨c3 aliased:any_value(body)⟩ AS sample, ⟨c4 aliased:string_agg(raw, '\\x00'::bytea)⟩ AS joined\nFROM events;

Name: Paths
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Paths, command: many)
SELECT
    jsonb_path_query_first(payload, '$.items[0]') AS first_item,
    jsonb_path_query_array(payload, '$.items[*].id') AS item_ids,
    jsonb_set(payload, tags, '1') AS tagged,
    jsonb_insert(payload, ARRAY['items', '0'], '{}', true) AS inserted,
    jsonb_set_lax(payload, '{gone}', NULL, true, 'delete_key') AS lax,
    jsonb_object(tags, tags) AS paired,
    num_nulls(body, NULL) AS nulls
FROM events;
Template:
SELECT
    ⟨c0 aliased:jsonb_path_query_first(payload, '$.items[0]')⟩ AS first_item,
    ⟨c1 aliased:jsonb_path_query_array(payload, '$.items[*].id')⟩ AS item_ids,
    ⟨c2 aliased:jsonb_set(payload, tags, '1')⟩ AS tagged,
    ⟨c3 aliased:jsonb_insert(payload, ARRAY['items', '0'], '{}', true)⟩ AS inserted,
    ⟨c4 aliased:jsonb_set_lax(payload, '{gone}', NULL, true, 'delete_key')⟩ AS lax,
    ⟨c5 aliased:jsonb_object(tags, tags)⟩ AS paired,
    ⟨c6 aliased:num_nulls(body, NULL)⟩ AS nulls
FROM events;

Name: Elements
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:jsonb_array_elements(payload -> 'items')⟩ AS item, ⟨c2 aliased:jsonb_object_keys(payload)⟩ AS key\nFROM events;

Name: Series
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:generate_series(1, 3)⟩ AS n, ⟨c1 aliased:generate_series(created_at, created_at + interval '2 days', interval '1 day')⟩ AS day\nFROM events;

Name: Ages
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:age(created_at, '2024-01-01')⟩ AS since_new_year, ⟨c2 aliased:date_bin('15 minutes', happened, '2000-01-01')⟩ AS slot\nFROM events;

Name: Roots
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Roots, command: one)
SELECT cbrt(27.0) AS cube_root, sqrt(amount) AS exact_root, degrees(ratio) AS angle
FROM events
WHERE id = $1;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:cbrt(27.0)⟩ AS cube_root, ⟨c1 aliased:sqrt(amount)⟩ AS exact_root, ⟨c2 aliased:degrees(ratio)⟩ AS angle\nFROM events\nWHERE id = ⟨p0⟩;⟨arguments p0⟩

Name: MedianRatio
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: MedianRatio, command: one)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ratio) AS median_ratio FROM events;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ratio)⟩ AS median_ratio FROM events;

Name: Retag
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Retag, command: exec)
UPDATE events SET payload = jsonb_set(payload, '{status}', '"done"') WHERE id = $1;
Template: UPDATE events SET payload = jsonb_set(payload, '{status}', '"done"') WHERE id = ⟨p0⟩;⟨arguments p0⟩

Name: LongIntervals
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: LongIntervals, command: many)
SELECT id, make_interval(days => $1) AS span FROM events;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:make_interval(days => ⟨p0⟩)⟩ AS span FROM events;⟨arguments p0⟩

Name: Bookings
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Bookings, command: many)
SELECT id, lower(booked) AS starts, upper(booked) AS ends, isempty(seats) AS unseated,
       lower_inf(booked) AS open_start, tstzrange($1, $2, '[)') AS window
FROM events;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:lower(booked)⟩ AS starts, ⟨c2 aliased:upper(booked)⟩ AS ends, ⟨c3 aliased:isempty(seats)⟩ AS unseated,\n       ⟨c4 aliased:lower_inf(booked)⟩ AS open_start, ⟨c5 aliased:tstzrange(⟨p0⟩, ⟨p1⟩, '[)')⟩ AS window\nFROM events;⟨arguments p0 p1⟩

Name: Moods
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Moods, command: one)
SELECT enum_first(NULL::mood) AS lowest, enum_last(feeling) AS highest, enum_range(NULL::mood) AS every_mood
FROM events
WHERE id = $1;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:enum_first(NULL::mood)⟩ AS lowest, ⟨c1 aliased:enum_last(feeling)⟩ AS highest, ⟨c2 aliased:enum_range(NULL::mood)⟩ AS every_mood\nFROM events\nWHERE id = ⟨p0⟩;⟨arguments p0⟩

Name: Cleaned
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Cleaned, command: many)
SELECT
    regexp_replace(body, '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS squeezed,
    regexp_match(body, '(\d+)') AS first_number,
    regexp_split_to_array(body, ',') AS parts,
    regexp_count(body, 'a') AS a_count,
    regexp_like(body, '^x', 'i') AS starts_with_x,
    regexp_substr(body, '\d+') AS digits,
    substring(body FROM '[0-9]+') AS pattern_match
FROM events;
Template:
SELECT
    ⟨c0 aliased:regexp_replace(body, '\s+', ' ', 'g')⟩ AS squeezed,
    ⟨c1 aliased:regexp_match(body, '(\d+)')⟩ AS first_number,
    ⟨c2 aliased:regexp_split_to_array(body, ',')⟩ AS parts,
    ⟨c3 aliased:regexp_count(body, 'a')⟩ AS a_count,
    ⟨c4 aliased:regexp_like(body, '^x', 'i')⟩ AS starts_with_x,
    ⟨c5 aliased:regexp_substr(body, '\d+')⟩ AS digits,
    ⟨c6 aliased:substring(body FROM '[0-9]+')⟩ AS pattern_match
FROM events;

Name: Digests
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Digests, command: one)
SELECT sha256(raw) AS digest, md5(raw) AS checksum, encode(sha512(raw), 'hex') AS long_digest,
       convert_from(raw, 'UTF8') AS decoded, convert_to(body, 'UTF8') AS encoded, to_hex(id) AS hex_id,
       length(raw) AS size, substring(raw FROM 1 FOR 4) AS head
FROM events
WHERE id = $1;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:sha256(raw)⟩ AS digest, ⟨c1 aliased:md5(raw)⟩ AS checksum, ⟨c2 aliased:encode(sha512(raw), 'hex')⟩ AS long_digest,
       ⟨c3 aliased:convert_from(raw, 'UTF8')⟩ AS decoded, ⟨c4 aliased:convert_to(body, 'UTF8')⟩ AS encoded, ⟨c5 aliased:to_hex(id)⟩ AS hex_id,
       ⟨c6 aliased:length(raw)⟩ AS size, ⟨c7 aliased:substring(raw FROM 1 FOR 4)⟩ AS head
FROM events
WHERE id = ⟨p0⟩;⟨arguments p0⟩
